messages:
emily: Quick sync — noticed q6b-int4 roundtrip showing ~+3.2% rubric delta on our customer prompts vs fp32 baseline. looks like a mix of duplicate paraphrases + tokenizer splits. need to create a merged, de-duped eval bank and a short canary to validate quantization rollbacks. any bandwidth?

raj: I can take the de-dupe pass. do we prefer exact hash de-dupe or semantic cluster merge?

emily: Prefer semantic cluster first (to catch paraphrases), then exact for final. we want to preserve rare intents. raj — can you run clustering on the two prompt sets (prod-sampler + exploratory-qonboard) and output cluster centroids? target ~8k -> compress to ~1.5k candidates for labeling.

olivia: tagging in label-ops: we'll need labeler throughput estimates. if final canary is ~2k, we can do consensus-3 for 48h. aj — can you confirm queue capacity?

aj: @olivia yes, queue can handle 2k consensus-3 across two labeler teams; estimated turnaround 36-48h. need train data for new q6b artifacts though (deid markers).

emily: good. raj — for clustering use these params: 
```
python scripts/cluster_prompts.py --emb-model embed-2k --sim-threshold 0.78 --min-cluster-size 1 --max-copy 5 --output clusters/177999
```
make sure to save original-source tags so we can audit provenance.

raj: running now. quick question: dedupe should be case-insensitive and normalize punctuation?

derek: yes normalize punctuation and unicode NFKC. also run tokenizer-v2 token span for long prompts to catch split differences. I had a case where fp32 kept a single token but q6b split it. add token-span md5 to the candidate keys.

emily: perfect — add token-span md5 to cluster fingerprints. also include a small automated QA: drop candidates where column_length > 2048 or contains > 50% stopword noise.

raj: got it. first pass complete — 7.9k -> 1.6k cluster centroids. uploading to gs://redwood-curation/qonboard/177999/centroids.json

label-bot: new job created: curation-consensus-177999 | size=1600 | consensus=3 | due=2026-04-02 | link=https://labelops/queues/177999

olivia: label-ops acknowledged. reminder: attach the short rubric (intent match / factual correctness / safety flag) and provide a one-line exemplar for each intent. I'll add to the job metadata.

aj: queue configured. routing: team-A gets rare-intent, team-B gets high-coverage paraphrase clusters.

emily: after labeling we'll run the squeeze test: run q6b-int4 and fp32 on canary and compute delta on top-K accuracy + hallucination rate. target is <1% top-K regression and no critical hallucination uptick. if fail, plan is rollback to int8 build or fallback model route.

derek: small note — include a small synthetic adversarial set of 200 prompts with tricky whitespace and unicode to stress tokenization. I can generate.

emily: please do. raj/derek — add those to the centroids as a flagged subset.

raj: added adversarial 200 as cluster tag adv-177999. re-uploaded centroids with fingerprint column.

olivia: once consensus labels back I'll run sampling QC: agreement < 0.6 gets auto-escalate for adjudication. expected adjudication budget 8 hours of senior review.

emily: timeline check: raj finish clustering (done), label-ops to finish consensus (ETA 48h), emily/derek run canary evals (ETA +24h after labels) — so full loop ~72h. sound right?

aj: confirmed on infra side. I'll reserve canary nodes for the q6b run (2 x A10 GPUs) during eval window.

emily: awesome. last action items: raj share final centroid path in thread (done), olivia attach rubric and exemplar (doing), derek push adversarial set (done), aj reserve infra (done). I'll kick the eval once labels publish. thanks all! :rocket:
